Game Overview

Spider Attack is a action title where fend off a relentless spider invasion from your rooftop in Spider Attack. Arm yourself with plants, strategically place them, and squash the arachnids climbing toward you. Test your reflexes and score-chasing skills in quick, thrilling, and tactical gameplay, where each move keeps the swarm at bay.
